archetypes.name: dyn-codex-pricing-split
archetypes.rationale: per-model Codex cost split has subtle reconciliation and back-compat edges
archetypes.prompt_body: Scrutinize the new per-(vendor,model) Codex pricing split. Verify CODEX_GPT_5_5_COST + CODEX_GPT_5_4_MINI_COST always reconciles to CODEX_COST and that grand totals still sum. Check back-compat: reports lacking BUCKETS_codex_by_model must price exactly as before (all gpt-5.5), and model-less or unknown-model rows must fall back to the gpt-5.5 default rate. Confirm the design_summary.py change reads cached_input (not cache_read) from the per-model buckets and that the gpt-5.5/mini routing in _codex_argv, _codex_token_argv, and _read_token_report never double-counts or drops tokens. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
